name: Yardi Breeze
description: Yardi Breeze is cloud property management software for residential, commercial, affordable, self storage, HOA/condo, and manufactured housing portfolios. Property teams use it for accounting, leasing, online payments, tenant and owner portals, maintenance, communications, reporting, marketing, and day-to-day portfolio operations.
agentUseSummary: Yardi Breeze cannot yet be connected through Relay as a direct self-service provider. Yardi's public API materials point to paid interface-partner and RentCafe data-exchange programs with license fees, Data Exchange Agreements, pilot clients, partner qualification, and confidential API specifications, while Breeze customer terms cover signed-in property-management use rather than distributable Relay API credentials.

blocked.label: Connect Yardi Breeze
blocked.description: Yardi does not publish a self-service Breeze API-key, OAuth, endpoint, scope, revocation, tenant-binding, or rate-limit contract that Relay can implement without partner approval and contractual data-exchange terms.

blocked.label: Read private property data
blocked.description: Properties, units, leases, tenants, prospects, owners, ledgers, balances, payments, maintenance, vendors, communications, documents, reports, accounting, marketing, resident portals, and account settings remain unavailable to Relay.

blocked.label: Change Yardi Breeze records
blocked.description: Creating, updating, importing, exporting, posting, paying, charging, reconciling, emailing, texting, archiving, deleting, or otherwise changing property-management records is blocked.

blocked.label: Operate payments or accounting
blocked.description: Rent collection, payment processing, deposits, owner distributions, payables, receivables, ledgers, journal entries, bank data, reconciliations, and financial reporting are blocked.

blocked.label: Use private Yardi interfaces
blocked.description: Browser automation, session cookies, user passwords, Client Central materials, private APIs, confidential partner specifications, screen scraping, traffic inspection, file-transfer channels, arbitrary requests, and unofficial endpoints are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Yardi Breeze action is enabled until Yardi and Relay approve a bounded interface-partner or RentCafe API contract covering credentials, common-client identity, data categories, property-management and accounting authority, limits, audit, retention, and revocation.

runtimeSupport.description: No Yardi Breeze tools are mounted without a verified Yardi interface agreement, approved common-client authority, and bounded data-exchange contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Yardi Breeze public product and legal materials describe a signed-in property-management system with sensitive tenant, prospect, owner, accounting, payment, maintenance, document, reporting, and communication data. Yardi's public API posture is an Interface Partner Program and RentCafe API Access/Data Exchange Agreement path with annual license fees, interface types, Data Exchange Agreements, pilot clients, partner qualification, confidential specifications, and common-client constraints. The public materials do not provide a self-service Breeze API origin, endpoint schema, credential issuance path, OAuth scopes, tenant and property binding, role matrix, file-transfer rules, pagination, rate limits, revocation, disconnect behavior, or third-party automation terms for Relay.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, partnerships, legal, privacy, security, property-management, accounting, payments, tenant-data, communications, and real-estate compliance owners must obtain Yardi's current interface documentation and signed data-exchange terms. Before implementation, freeze the exact Yardi product boundary, common-client identity, interface type, credential ownership, roles, readable fields, write authority, payments/accounting exclusions, file-transfer handling, resident and owner consent, bounds, audit, retention, revocation, deletion, and disconnect behavior, then complete live acceptance in the provider-console task.

evidence.supports: Yardi Breeze's product site identifies Breeze as cloud property-management software for residential, commercial, affordable, self storage, HOA/condo, and manufactured-housing portfolios with built-in accounting and support.

Yardi says API access is provided through its Interface Partner Program, requires annual license fees, partner qualification, Data Exchange Agreements, development, pilot testing, and approved-interface release.
Yardi lists standard interface categories, including web-service and file-transfer interfaces, but presents them as approved vendor programs rather than self-service customer API credentials.
Yardi's RentCafe API terms require an API Access Agreement, define common-client data and business-purpose limits, and state that technical/API specifications are confidential.

Yardi Breeze Terms of Use govern signed-in customer use of the property-management software, client data, data export through standard functionality, support, payments, communications, and license restrictions.
Yardi publishes a privacy statement covering Yardi services, client data, visitors, personal information, and data-protection practices.
